I am an old woman, sixty years, and I have farmed this small piece of land behind my house for many years. My husband is gone and my children help small-small, but money is not plenty, so I use what I can afford and what I know. I will plant my maize together with melon and small cassava like I always do, use the droppings from my goats and chickens, and buy a little fertilizer from the market if the price is not too high. I cannot pay for pump water or plenty hired hands, so my own hands and my grandchildren will do most of the work.
